title:
Laud we the gods
 And let our crooked smokes climb to their nostrils
 From our bless’d altars.
html_source: From the closing lines of Cymbeline, spoken by the title character.

anchor.text:
Laud we the gods
 And let our crooked smokes climb to their nostrils
 From our bless'd altars.
anchor.prefix:
in a flaw of softness softly were blown. 

 Cease to strive. Peace of the druid priests of Cymbeline, hierophantic: from wide earth an altar.
